## Stable problem codes (19)

Branch on `code`; use the exit status only as a coarse shell category. `retryable` in an emitted problem is authoritative for that occurrence.

| Code | Exit | Normally retryable | Meaning |
| --- | ---: | --- | --- |
| `INVALID_INVOCATION` | `2` | no | Invocation syntax, typed input, or local validation failed. |
| `UNKNOWN_CAPABILITY` | `2` | no | The requested Capability ID is not in the compiled catalog. |
| `CONFIG_INVALID` | `3` | no | Configuration or authentication material is invalid. |
| `PRODUCT_GATE_REQUIRED` | `4` | no | A billed product or sensitive-output acknowledgement is missing. |
| `AMBIGUOUS_PLACE` | `5` | no | A Place Spec matched multiple safe candidates. |
| `PLACE_NOT_FOUND` | `5` | no | A Place Spec did not match a QWeather place. |
| `UPSTREAM_REJECTED` | `6` | no | QWeather permanently rejected the request. |
| `RATE_LIMITED` | `7` | yes | A rate or usage limit was reached. |
| `NETWORK_ERROR` | `8` | yes | The provider request failed at the network boundary. |
| `TIMEOUT` | `8` | yes | The provider request exceeded its deadline. |
| `UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE` | `8` | yes | QWeather returned a temporary server failure. |
| `UPSTREAM_PROTOCOL_ERROR` | `9` | no | The provider response or request violated the protocol contract. |
| `CACHE_IO_ERROR` | `10` | no | A persistent cache operation failed. |
| `CAPABILITY_NOT_IMPLEMENTED` | `10` | no | A compiled Capability mapping is unavailable. |
| `COMMAND_TREE_INVALID` | `10` | no | The compiled command tree could not be constructed. |
| `CONTROL_NOT_IMPLEMENTED` | `10` | no | A compiled local control operation is unavailable. |
| `INTERNAL_ERROR` | `10` | no | A broken internal invariant was detected. |
| `OUTPUT_ERROR` | `10` | no | Writing the selected output failed. |

## Provider Body mode

`--output body` is valid only for a successful provider query. It writes the byte-exact successful Provider Body with no added newline. Failures remain QWeather-owned Text Problems on stderr and never expose provider error bodies.
